children: Cato announces plans to close approximately 120 stores in fiscal 2026 and expects $1.0–$1.3 million in costs to exit additional locations.
Plans to close ~70 additional underperforming stores in Q3 and Q4, bringing total planned closures to ~120 in fiscal 2026.
Company expects $1.0 million to $1.3 million in costs through end of 2026 related to signage, fixtures and returning systems.
Stores targeted are at lease end, so no rent obligations for these locations beyond 2026.
Management expects closures to positively impact operating results in fiscal 2027 and beyond.
